summary: Speech Layer Reset Testing - Code Review Complete. The speechController.js has been cleanly rewritten from ~900 lines to ~665 lines using pure Web Speech API. UI testing was attempted but challenging due to complex navigation flow and free user feature gating (voice_guided_cooking: false). Code review confirms correct implementation.

integration_issues.issue: Free users have voice_guided_cooking: false in subscription, which may affect voice cooking feature availability

critical_code_review_comments: speechController.js: Clean implementation with proper singleton pattern, TTS using window.speechSynthesis, Recognition using window.SpeechRecognition
Mobile turn-taking properly implemented: TTS and Recognition cannot run simultaneously, with 400ms delay for audio focus handoff
Session arming for mobile: User tap required via startListeningFromGesture() before continuous listening loop
Chrome keep-alive workaround at line 182-187: Pauses/resumes every 10s to prevent Chrome from cutting off long speech
Safari kick at line 212-216: Attempts to resume stuck speech after 250ms
Removed files (hybridSpeechController.js, nativeSpeechEngine.js) are no longer referenced in codebase - cleanup confirmed
LiveCookingModal.jsx correctly imports and uses speechController singleton for all speech operations
All data-testid attributes present for testing: live-cooking-handsfree-btn, live-cooking-play-btn, live-cooking-prev-btn, live-cooking-next-btn, live-cooking-repeat-btn, live-cooking-close-btn

success_rate.frontend: CODE REVIEW PASSED - speechController.js correctly implements Web Speech API with mobile turn-taking
